scope: NACC only; aggregate measured-composition sensitivity; no causal closure or human gate

rules.baseline: Actual NACCVNUM=1, valid initial state, baseline age 50-120 in primary; do not substitute a later usable diagnosis.
rules.clock: NACCFDYS is per-visit elapsed days since initial; NACCDAYS is not used as the longitudinal clock.
rules.states: NACCUDSD 1/3/4 mapped to CN/MCI/dementia 1/2/3. Code2 impaired-not-MCI and code8 behavioral-only impairment are excluded, not relabelled.
rules.mode: All valid clinical diagnosis packets primary. IT/T are legacy telephone packets; UDSv4 standard packets may also contain remote forms.
rules.death: NACCDIED=0 combines not-known-deceased with unknown; NACCYOD is year only. Do not manufacture an exact death date or count all code0 as confirmed alive.
rules.genotype: NACCAPOE1..6 valid; carrier codes2/4/5. NACCNE4S0..2 valid counts;9 missing. Genotype fields are cross-sectional and may have been ascertained after entry.
rules.smoking: TOBAC100 is lifetime >100 cigarettes, not current smoking. Codes0/1 valid;9/-4 missing.
rules.hearing: HEARING0 means hearing not functionally normal without aids;1 means normal;9/-4 missing.
rules.diabetes: DIABETES0 absent,1 recent/active,2 remote/inactive; type2 needs DIABTYPE2 and is not interchangeable with all diabetes.
